The '''QuickSnap 36T''' was a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]].<ref name="GG9" /> The QuickSnap 36T was usually available for purchase in large [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]], but was also readily available on backwater [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. A fee or permit was usually required to purchase the weapon, and their use was restricted; depending on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], they either needed appropriate licenses, or were illegal.<ref name="GS">''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen]]''</ref>

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operative [[Matt Talon]] carried a QuickSnap 36T as part of his personal arsenal.<ref name="GG9" /> The [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] employee Alliance informant [[Burellion Tiy]] carried a QuickSnap 36T.<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> [[Lusubrin T'shkali]], a [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] warrior who fought in the [[Dool Arena]] at [[The Broken Tusk (Reuss VIII)|The Broken Tusk]] on [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]], wielded a QuickSnap 36T.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
